scheme_name: Assistance For Major Ailments (Karmika Chikitsa Bhagya) (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
other_conditions: The applicant must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
The worker must be a registered construction worker under the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
Application must be submitted within 6 months of the hospitalisation commencement date.
Registration must be renewed every 3 years, with a 1‑year grace period after expiry.
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance up to ₹2,00,000 for treatment of specified major ailments.
